     :

  have h2e_ne_zero : 2 * e ≠ 0 := by omega
  have h_congr : n * (n + k * (↑p : ℤ)) ≡ n * n [ZMOD (↑p : ℤ)] := by
    rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
    exact ⟨-(n * k), by ring⟩
  have h_pow_congr : (n * (n + k * (↑p : ℤ))) ^ e ≡ (n * n) ^ e [ZMOD (↑p : ℤ)] :=
    h_congr.pow e
  have h_pow_eq : (n * n) ^ e = n ^ (2 * e) := by
    rw [show n * n = n ^ 2 from by ring, ← pow_mul]
  have h_mod_pow_iff : (n * (n + k * (↑p : ℤ))) ^ e ≡ 0 [ZMOD (↑p : ℤ)] ↔ (n * n) ^ e ≡ 0 [ZMOD (↑p : ℤ)] := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact h_pow_congr.symm.trans h
    · intro h
      exact h_pow_congr.trans h
  have hp_prime_int : Prime (↑p : ℤ) := by
    rw [Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime]
    simpa using hp
  have h_dvd_pow_iff : (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ (2 * e) := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact dvd_pow h h2e_ne_zero
    · intro h

  have h_dvd_pow_iff' : (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ (↑p : ℤ) ∣ (n * n) ^ e := by
    have h1 : (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ^ (2 * e) ↔ (↑p : ℤ) ∣ (n * n) ^ e := by
      rw [← h_pow_eq]
    exact h_dvd_pow_iff.trans h1
  have h_dvd_mod : (↑p : ℤ) ∣ (n * n) ^ e ↔ (n * n) ^ e ≡ 0 [ZMOD (↑p : ℤ)] :=
    Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.symm
  have h1 : (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ (n * n) ^ e ≡ 0 [ZMOD (↑p : ℤ)] :=
    h_dvd_pow_iff'.trans h_dvd_mod

      exact Int.emod_eq_zero_of_dvd h

      have h₉ : n % (p : ℤ) = 0 := h₂

        simp [Int.mul_emod]

      have h₆ : (n % (p : ℤ)) = 0 := h₂
      have h₇ : ((n + k * (p : ℤ)) % (p : ℤ)) = 0 := h₃
      rw [h₆, h₇]

    have h₅ : (n * (n + k * (p : ℤ))) ^ e ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
      have h₆ : (n * (n + k * (p : ℤ))) % (p : ℤ) = 0 := h₄
      have h₇ : (n * (n + k * (p : ℤ))) ^ e % (p : ℤ) = 0 := by

        have h₉ : (p : ℤ) ∣ (n * (n + k * (p : ℤ))) ^ e := by
          exact dvd_pow h₈ (by

          exact Int.emod_eq_zero_of_dvd h₉
        exact h₁₀
      
      have h₈ : (n * (n + k * (p : ℤ))) ^ e ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
        rw [Int.ModEq]
        exact h₇
      exact h₈
    exact h₅
  
  have h_backward : (n * (n + k * (↑p : ℤ))) ^ e ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] → (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n := by

      have h₆₂ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n ∨ (p : ℤ) ∣ (n + k * (↑p : ℤ)) := by
        
        have h₆₃ : (p : ℕ).Prime := hp
        have h₆₄ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n * (n + k * (↑p : ℤ)) := h₆₁
        exact (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by simpa using hp)).dvd_mul.mp h₆₄
      exact h₆₂
    
    have h₇ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n := by
      cases h₆ with

        have h₇₁ : (p : ℤ) ∣ (n + k * (↑p : ℤ)) := h₆

            exact Int.dvd_sub h₇₁ h₇₃
          have h₇₅ : (n + k * (↑p : ℤ)) - (k * (↑p : ℤ)) = n := by
            ring
          rw [h₇₅] at h₇₄
          exact h₇₄
        exact h₇₂
    exact h₇
  
  have h_main : (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ (n * (n + k * (↑p : ℤ))) ^ e ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      exact h_forward h
    · 
      intro h
      exact h_backward h
  
  exact h_main

    (n k : ℤ) (p e B : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (he_pos : 0 < e)
     :
    (↑p : ℤ) ∣ n ↔ (n * (n + k * (↑p : ℤ))) ^ e ≡ 0 [ZMOD p] := by

    rw [Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime]
    simpa using hp

      (Int.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).2 hn
    have hfactor :
        n + k * (p : ℤ) ≡ n + k * (p : ℤ) [ZMOD (p : ℤ)] :=
      Int.ModEq.refl _
    have hprod :
        n * (n + k * (p : ℤ)) ≡ 0 [ZMOD (p : ℤ)] := by
      simpa using hn'.mul hfactor
    simpa [Nat.ne_of_gt he_pos] using hprod.pow e
  · intro h
    have hpow : (p : ℤ) ∣ (n * (n + k * (p : ℤ))) ^ e :=

      rcases hkp with ⟨d, hd⟩
